title: Shosales Website Revamp & Testing
subtitle: 10x Page Load Speedup & Parallel E2E Test Automation
summary: 10x performance improvement in web page rendering, parallel test suite execution with Laravel Dusk and Selenium across UK real estate platform.
overview: Revamp project for UK real estate platform Shosales, focused on web performance optimization, SQL query refactoring, and automated E2E testing.
roleDescription: Head of Full-Stack Development at Full Comms.
responsibilities: Refactored N+1 queries and implemented caching strategies to achieve a 10x rendering speedup.
Implemented automated E2E test suites with Laravel Dusk and headless Selenium browsers.
Parallelized test execution in continuous delivery pipelines (DeployHQ).

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Sluggish property listing pages caused by unoptimized relational SQL queries.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Eager loading (with) in Laravel Eloquent, MySQL composite indexing, and multi-tier caching.

metrics: 10x speedup in web page response times
Reduced continuous integration build duration via parallel Dusk execution
